title: Count the Vowels
instructions:
Complete the `countVowels` function. It takes a `text` parameter of type `String` and returns an `Int` — the number of vowels (a, e, i, o, u) in the string.

The check should be case-insensitive, so both `'A'` and `'a'` count as vowels.
hint: Convert the text to lowercase first, then loop through each character and check if it is in "aeiou".
